title: Aoyagi Toya — Happy Birthday! 2025〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Toya's birthday
Tenma Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line: We're glad you're here, Toya!

rows.Speaker: Saki's Voice
rows.Line: Welcome! Please, come on in♪

rows.Speaker: Toya's Voice
rows.Line: Okay. Pardon me.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
These decorations... They're all made out of origami and other crafts.
It all looks so lovely and extravagant.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Was this your handiwork, Saki?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You can tell?! That's Toya for you!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay, I'm in the lead with one point♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Heh, not for long.
Take a close look at the table, Toya!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Oh, those sandwiches look delicious.
You've even decorated with flowers...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hah hah hah!
This is the very ESSENCE of hospitality!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: However, this is only the beginning! No, only the “B”!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Today, Toya, I'll leave you stunned, speechless and smiling!
And to that end, I've prepared a magic show for you!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: A magic show...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I remember you putting some on for me when we were little. How nostalgic...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah! So you do remember!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: To tell the truth, I went around asking Rui, Nene, Akito and Shiraishi for ideas on what sort of birthday party you would enjoy.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: In the end, we came upon the thought that it should be one which is possible specifically because of all the time we've spent together!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And after much deliberation, I came up with this nostalgic magic show idea!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You had such a great smile when I put them on back then. So today, I'll use my new tricks to make it reappear!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay. I'm very much looking forward to it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That reminds me, I heard that you spoke with Akiyama about today, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yup! Kohane, Haruka and Emu helped out a bunch too!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And the theme I landed on for my birthday idea was “Play together for lots of laughs”... So...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I actually put together a remake of one of the games the three of us played way back when!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wh-What did you say...?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So you've also prepared a nostalgic activity for us, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Sheesh, I can't believe we came up with the same thing after talking with different people!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But the game I put together isn't just the same old, it's leveled up! You can expect great stuff♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I see...
As expected of my sister, you never disappoint!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Saki, it's time to see who can make today more fun for Toya... Let us have a fair match!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Bring it on, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Great! Now, you two, please pick a glass of juice from the table!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I hereby declare Toya's birthday celebration begun!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Cheers!

rows.Speaker: Toya & Saki
rows.Line:
Cheers.
Cheers♪

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Oh, I rolled a five.
That means... I stop at this space with the drawing of Saki on it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Ooh! You hit the jackpot, Toya!
Here's your snack prize♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Saki, do I also get a treat if I land there?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Swing and a miss. We're rivals today, so you would get a penalty!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now then, it's time for Mr. Pegasus' Mystifying Magic Show to begin!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
First, a little warm-up.
I'll make this coin disappear!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I take this perfectly average coin, and run a table napkin over it... You can tell the coin is still here through the cloth, yes?

rows.Speaker: Toya & Saki
rows.Line:
Yes.
Uh-huh.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: However! Mr. Pegasus' magic hands can make it disappear simply by grasping it! Watch!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whaaat?! The coin's gone?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Incredible... My mind understands that there must be a trick to it, but I couldn't find any tells.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hah hah hah! Don't be surprised just yet! Look, next I shall make that sandwich disappear!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you both very much.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I was certain this would be a great birthday, but I enjoyed it twice as much as I expected... No, even more than that.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hah hah hah hah hah!
Of course you did, with the two of us leading things!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now, I believe it's about time to decide our match.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Which was more fun, Toya?
My game, or Tsukasa's show?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Oh no...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I was having so much fun, I completely forgot about the contest.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (How could I let this happen...? They were both so passionate about their battle, but I simply enjoyed myself without a care in the world!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm...? Toya?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
No, it's not too late.
I'll just remember each thing that happened since I arrived.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: First were the decorations in the living room and on the table. I'd struggle to decide which of them did better at that stage.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: After that was the board game, which was a masterful expansion on the old handmade one we played as kids. That provided a mix of nostalgia and excitement.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Toya? You with us...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But Tsukasa's magic show had nostalgia too, and was also full of humor and rife with surprises. Before I knew it, my eyes were glued to his performance.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What am I to compare, and by what means? How am I to decide a winner and loser?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Point deductions... No, there was nothing to take away points for... So, I award points?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But for me to assign point values to their ideas and passionate creativity...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Still, if I don't come to a decision somehow, I won't be able to give these two the answer they wa—

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: T-Toya, our apologies!!! This was wrong!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Sorry, Toya!
We didn't mean to stress you out like this!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That was our mistake, Toya. We became too swept up in it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, I should be the one apologizing.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It's hard to say whether the game or the show “won.”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I really...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I truly had so much fun.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Great. And I'm glad I get to see this smile.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, me too!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Toya!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Thank you...
I really appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Toya!

rows.Speaker: Airi & Shizuku
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Thanks for looking out for Akito.
He gets in over his head if you leave him be, so it's a huge help that you're around.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Funny, you're talking like an older sister or something.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Because I am one, thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. It's so important to have someone by your side chasing the same dream.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Right. I'm sure you don't need to hear this, but be sure to take good care of your friends.
I hope your birthday's great!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Aoyagi.
Did you enjoy Mr. Pegasus' magic show?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Rui helped me with the finer movements and Nene gave me advice on how to communicate with my audience. It all came very much in handy during the show!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It did? I'm glad I was able to contribute a little.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Um, Aoyagi... Happy birthday.
I'll bring your present and stuff on Monday.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehehe. We chose the finest gift available. I'm sure you'll like it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Toya♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka & Emu
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haruka, Emu, Mizuki! Thanks for helping me decide what kind of game to do and stuff!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe, it was for a special occasion.
I wanted to help make his birthday a good one.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! I'm happy Toya's all smiles too☆

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Same here! Wish I could've seen it myself...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Then, let's all go celebrate now♪
We'll get to see him all smiley!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Awesome plan!
Okay guys, let's get going! Go, go, go!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh? Otori?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whoa, Mizuki, wait!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Toya.

rows.Speaker: Kohane & An
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I guess you never decided on a winner of Saki and Tsukasa's competition. I'm curious how they decided to celebrate.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, since we came up with a bunch of ideas! You'll have to tell us which parts you liked.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It won't be long before we see him at practice. Just ask him then.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: True that!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
We'll talk to you later, Aoyagi.
See you at practice!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: My birthday party with Tsukasa and Saki was so much fun.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Evidently, Kamishiro, Kiritani and many others discussed ideas with them.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: To think so many people gave my birthday that much thought...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm so grateful.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: They celebrated my birthday from the bottom of their hearts.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That means I need to keep this feeling of gratitude with me as I live out the year.
